name: Mineralised structure
failures: Osteoporotic loss, enamel erosion that never regenerates, non-union fractures.

see.note: DEXA and CT quantify mineral directly.

model.note: Density and microarchitecture targets are established.

edit.note: Bone remodels and can be pharmacologically shifted. Enamel is never regenerated once lost.

anchors: Enamel is acellular and has no regenerative capacity in humans
